doc: The control plane's read model: the routing table, the tasks mirrored from the code host, the run records and the audit log.

glossary.meaning: The founder-owned table saying which model fills each tier and which tier takes each job
One tier of the routing table and the model that fills it
One job kind of the routing table and the tier that takes it
A task issue on the code host, read with its state, risk and kind
Where a task stands, from the issue's state label
What the runner records about one attempt at a task: the tier, the routing row that chose it, the model used and the outcome
How a run ended, or running while it has not
One line of the append-only audit log: who did what to which subject, and when

functions.name: task_from_issue

params.name: labels
params.doc: In the order the code host lists them

rules: The state comes from the labels that start with state: ; the part after the colon, with hyphens read as underscores, must be a TaskState other than unlabelled and conflict, or the label is ignored
One such label gives that state, none gives unlabelled, more than one gives conflict
The risk is the part after risk: of the first label that starts with it, and the kind likewise after kind: ; empty when there is none
The number, title and milestone are copied

functions.name: page_size
functions.doc: How many items a list returns
rules: Returns 50 when limit is 0 or negative
